name: ftpii
author: joedj, leo60228
description_short: An FTP server for the GameCube
description_long: ftpii turns a GameCube with a Broadband Adapter or compatible network adapter into an FTP server, letting you access files on supported storage devices from a computer over the network. It supports SD Gecko and SD2SP2 storage, optional password protection, device remounting, and standard FTP file operations without repeatedly moving the storage card between devices.
